title: Universal cumulative degree-zero exchange over a field
statement: Let K be a field and f:X to Spec K a locally finite-type quasi-compact morphism. For every positive natural number n, the universal cumulative base-change property BC(f,n,0) of [def-kun-bc-property] holds, with exactly its canonical unbounded exchange [def-kun-unbounded-exchange] and module coefficients. No invertibility assumption on n is needed.

source.place: Tag 0F1I, lemma-punctual-base-change, degree-zero and bounded-exponent reductions; Tag 073E, filtered colimits

proof.text: Let P be the perfect closure of K in its algebraic closure. The morphism Spec P to Spec K is a universal homeomorphism. Reduce X_P; the reduction morphism is a surjective closed immersion and hence a universal homeomorphism. The reduced finite-type P-scheme has flat finitely presented geometrically reduced structure morphism.

After any S to Spec K, construct S_P and the base change of the reduction over S_P by explicit pullback lifts. Pullback pasting and cancellation identify the resulting square as the base change of the reduced structure morphism. Flat degree-zero exchange applies. Paste the exchange with the two universal-homeomorphism squares in both ways, cancel the invertible comparison factors, and reflect the result by the inverse-image equivalence.

The degree-zero augmentation comparison identifies this underived mate with zeroth cohomology of the exact unbounded exchange. Negative cohomology is zero: right derived direct image on a sheaf is nonnegative and exact inverse image preserves nonnegativity. A map between zero objects is invertible.

theorem unboundedCumulativeFieldBaseChange_zero
    {K : Type u} [Field K] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    UnboundedCumulativeUniversalBaseChangeProperty f n hn 0
